name: Uisce Laurel
source:
Leader of the resistance against the Empire—the Elysian Liberation Front.

He is also a master distiller of Elysian whiskey, a local specialty. His blend is known among The City's noble circles as the "Queen of Whiskey."

He says he's rebelling because of how the Empire rules their subjects.
